# IFN response and OA markers (fabricated claims)

Differential expression analysis in the IFN-stimulated versus OA cohort revealed strong activation of antiviral genes. IFIT1 showed marked downregulation with a log2 fold change of -4.2 (Table 2). ISG15 was decreased in the treated arm (Table 2). OAS1 was downregulated in the OA donor samples (Table 2).

IFIT3 was upregulated as expected for ISG clusters (Table 2). MX1 was strongly upregulated (Table 2). Cartilage-relevant genes were also modulated: ACAN was upregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was strongly upregulated with log2FC of 3.5 (Table 2).

HMOX1 expression was unchanged near baseline (Table 2). GAPDH served as the internal reference (Table 2).
